tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts cities --builder grok-4.6 --url http://127.0.0.1:3121/cities — cursor-agent not logged in, grok CLI missing, claude CLI missing. Separate judge claude-sonnet-5 via Cursor Task (three scorings of the ten PNGs in one call, rubric v1-2026-09-12). The builder, grok-4.6, did not grade the page.

tasteReview.beats: Beats Zillow Bend homes (zillow.com/bend-or) on sourced interactive market depth: a live city-vs-region comparison combobox and a two-named-bar months-of-supply gauge. Loses to Zillow on breadth of the visible city list and per-city photography.
tasteReview.dullest: The Homes in Bend and nearby photo carousel at the foot of the insight-open shot: a bare photo row with a 01/09 counter and no visible affordance beyond a half-cropped arrow.
tasteReview.verdict: The fold now carries a navy-mark Atlas, a two-named-bar MOS gauge with a sourced verdict, a working beui combobox (search + checkmarked list, Central Oregon only) and a beautifului Insight card (pager + 335 face + scrub line). demoMatch true for the combobox and insight pieces on the evidence shown. Opening the combobox still squeezes the alerts sentence. Finish line 70 not reached.

defects.finding: With the Overlay a city against the region combobox open, the alert sentence and its NEW LISTINGS 256 figure collapse into a narrow column that word-wraps and the figure disappears, breaking the layout-lock pairing of drawing plus figure beside the alerts sentence.
The navy marks overlap into a dark smear over the Bend-Redmond cluster instead of reading as distinct place-anchored marks.
The Balanced-market verdict is stated three times in a row (inline sentence, the scale labels, and the caption under the scale), which reads as padding rather than one confident claim.

defects.section: Homes in Bend and nearby carousel
defects.finding: The photo rail's only interaction cue is a faint partial arrow at the frame edge and a bare 01/09 counter; next to Atlas and Insight it reads as a stock template rail rather than a composed section with its own claim.

tasteReview.rebaselineReason: evaluatorModel grok-4.6 to claude-sonnet-5 (grok CLI and cursor-agent missing; claude-sonnet-5 is the fallback judge). rubricVersion v1-2026-09-10 to v1-2026-09-12. shotsHash changed with combo-open and insight-open capture.
tasteReview.notes: honestyFunction 8, equal to the prior mark's 8. SEO rose: title names live inventory; CollectionPage ItemList covers the directory; listing ItemList plus FAQ/Dataset JSON-LD. Information rose: leftover detached count and Atlas all-types count are labeled on the same fold; listing rails carry priced homes; InsightCards publish leftover months. UX rose: installed InsightCards, beui-number, and beui combobox imported from app/cities/_v3. taste-evaluate.ts: all judge CLIs missing; JSON is the claude-sonnet-5 Task scoring of the same PNGs. No competitiveBrief on this class, so competitiveBriefPass is not required and is not invented.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason.
